hints.title: Prefix Digit Segmentation Obstacle
hints.text: Each letter decodes from either a single digit between '1' and '9' or two digits between '10' and '26'. How can tracking valid decodings of prefixes build up combinations while handling invalid '0' placements?

hints.title: Two-Step Lookback Invariant
hints.text: The number of decodings for prefix of length i equals the sum of decodings of length i - 1 (if the single digit is valid) and decodings of length i - 2 (if the two-digit pair is between 10 and 26).

hints.title: Fibonacci-Style Valid Digit Transition Procedure
hints.text: If the string starts with '0', return 0 immediately. Track decodings for lengths i - 1 and i - 2 using scalar variables. For each character from index 1 onwards, compute combinations contributed by the single digit and two-digit suffix, rolling the variables forward. If combinations reach 0 at any step, return 0.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass checks 1-digit and 2-digit validity using O(1) state variables.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branching across 1 or 2 digit choices takes O(2^N) exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintaining only the previous two prefix counts requires O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handling leading zeros and internal zeros properly without out-of-bounds errors.
